title: The Soother Fell Into Dragon Land
blurb: Petra throws her brother's soother over the mountains and follows it into Dragon Land, where a small orange dragon has already found it and a sleepy one will only trade.

endings.2: happy: the soother comes home and the dragons keep the boot

beats.ch01.s01.b001: The sun is warm and the clothesline flaps.
beats.ch01.s01.b004: I have had enough of this soother.
beats.ch01.s01.b005: The soother spins up into the green sky.
beats.ch01.s02.b001: The sky is green and bubbles pop with a soft plop.
beats.ch02.s01.b001: The cave walls sparkle like gold and Grumble snores on a pile of treasures.
beats.ch02.s01.b003: What is in it for me?
beats.ch02.s02.b001: The friendly wind sets Petra down by the clothesline.
beats.ch02.s02.b004: Pip grins and throws the soother again.
beats.ch02.s02.b006: At least the dragons are happy.
